mapper.sql: select menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, query, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_menu
mapper.delete: update sys_menu set del_flag = '2' where menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.select: select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id inner join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''
select menu_id from sys_role_menu where role_id = #{roleId}
